scripts.device:start: start "" "%LOCALAPPDATA%/Android/Sdk/emulator/emulator.exe" -avd pixel && adb wait-for-device && adb shell "while [ -z \"$(getprop sys.boot_completed)\" ]; do sleep 2; done"
scripts.start: adb install -r apps/mobile/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk && adb shell am start -n io.github.wonderwall1995.cypress_realworld_for_personal_portfolio_mobile/.MainActivity
scripts.device:stop: adb shell am force-stop io.github.wonderwall1995.cypress_realworld_for_personal_portfolio_mobile & adb emu kill
